description: High-severity npm advisories accepted for one lockfile directory, with the reason. tools/quality/npm-audit.mjs ignores only these advisories and fails when an exception no longer matches, so each entry is removed as soon as a fixed release reaches the lockfile.

exceptions.reason: Stack exhaustion through deeply nested brace patterns; no braces release is patched (<= 3.0.3). The only path is the documentation lint tool markdownlint-cli2 (already the latest version) through micromatch. It runs on developer machines and CI, and expands only the globs in docs/.markdownlint-cli2.mjs, so no untrusted pattern reaches braces.
